script_text: A silent seismic shift in your values rocks Taurus this week. Monday sees Venus, your Earth-ruling planet, sextile Pluto in your 10th House, sparking career money gains. The midweek turning point comes as Mercury opposite Neptune in your 4th and 10th Houses blurs focus. Thursday through Sunday, Sun trines Mars in your 7th House, lifting partnerships and weekend joy. Friday’s Jupiter in your 1st House trine Venus in your 5th House boosts love and side income. The weekend favors earth-element grounding to secure gains. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of romance. Tuesday is worst as Mars square Saturn hits love and career. Anchor money in tangible earth routines, not whims. Follow for daily updates.
